channel.title: Playwright on Aby George A
channel.description: Recent content in Playwright on Aby George A

item.title: Keeping Code Clean: Linting, Hooks, and Long-Term Governance
item.description: Using ESLint, Prettier, Husky, and lint-staged to keep a Playwright TypeScript framework healthy over months of active development, plus selector governance rules.

item.title: Maximizing Speed: Worker Optimization and CI Sharding
item.description: Tuning Playwright workers and using --shard to split large test suites across parallel CI jobs for faster feedback.

item.title: Automating Quality: Running Playwright in GitHub Actions
item.description: Setting up a GitHub Actions workflow for Playwright using the official Docker image and archiving reports as artifacts.

item.title: Debugging with Confidence: Traces, Screenshots, and HTML Reports
item.description: Using Playwright's HTML reporter, screenshots, video, and the trace viewer to diagnose CI failures quickly.

item.title: Speeding Up Execution: Combining API Setup with UI Validation
item.description: Using Playwright's built-in APIRequestContext to seed state through the API and speed up hybrid UI and API test flows.

item.title: Eliminating Flakiness: Auto-Waiting and Web-First Assertions
item.description: How Playwright's auto-waiting and web-first assertions remove the need for arbitrary sleeps and reduce flaky UI tests.

item.title: Supercharging Tests with Native Playwright Fixtures
item.description: Using Playwright's test.extend to build custom fixtures for page objects, authenticated sessions, and clean context isolation.

item.title: Decoupling Data: Managing Test Inputs and Dynamic States
item.description: Managing static and dynamic test data in Playwright with JSON files and @faker-js/faker, and avoiding data collisions in parallel runs.

item.title: Scaling Maintenance: Implementing the Page Object Model (POM)
item.description: How to build a maintainable Page Object Model in Playwright with TypeScript, including base pages and reusable components.

item.title: Laying the Foundation: Architecture and Setup for a Playwright Project
item.description: How to scaffold a clean, scalable Playwright TypeScript project, from folder structure to config.
